messages:
incident-bot: Paging: Dedicated pool 'solaris-enterprise-prod' reporting sustained GPU saturation (avg util >95%), queue length climbing, eviction count increasing. Severity: P1. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/infr/dash/pool/solaris-enterprise-prod :rotating_light:
erin_oncall: ack — investigating. Paging @sam_sre and @raj_cse. I'll grab the first triage and keep this channel for live updates.
sam_sre: on it. pulling metrics and recent job traces now.
raj_cse: Solaris (customer) reports elevated 5xxs and high tail latency on /v1/generate since ~08:12 UTC. They're seeing ~40% requests >5s.
sam_sre: initial read: one tenant (solar-batch-worker) is submitting very large batch jobs + long contexts (~20k-32k tokens). Batches and KV cache pressure causing persistent GPU residency and backlog. Current queue: 220; avg wait ~4.6s; preemption evictions ++.
sam_sre: mitigation options: (A) burst allocate overflow GPUs (+4) to this dedicated pool, (B) temporarily route Solaris to smaller model variant (downgrade) — customer refused, (C) apply route-level throttles for non-critical keys, (D) kill runaway job if it's customer-side. Which do we want first?
lucy_prodops: approve (A) burst for 30m to buy time. Per contract Solaris has burst allowance. :thumbsup: Need confirmation from raj that customer consents to temporary routing to overflow.
raj_cse: Solaris rep called — they approve temporary burst into overflow GPUs but explicitly no model downgrade. They want ETA and to be kept in loop.
sam_sre: executing burst now. Command:```
redwoodctl pools burst --pool-id=solaris-enterprise-prod --gpus=4 --duration=30m --reason="emergency overflow for tenant spike"
```
sam_sre: also enacting soft QoS on non-critical routes to reduce throughput pressure:```
redwoodctl routes update --customer=solaris --exclude=generate-critical --rate-limit=20rps
```
incident-bot: Burst request accepted. 4 GPUs allocated from overflow pool to solars-enterprise-prod. Scheduling policy updated; jobs rebalanced.
sam_sre: queue down to ~30 within 2m, tail latency down to ~400ms. Memory pressure easing. Monitoring closely.
erin_oncall: handing off active incident to @sam_sre for remediation and RCA. I'll remain on rotation for 15m for verification then stand down if stable.
lucy_prodops: follow-up action: create ticket to review dedicated autoscale policy + reduce provisioning latency for burst events. Also need stricter tenant-level isolation (limit single-tenant batch size) — assigning to infra/product.
raj_cse: Solaris confirms API errors and slow responses have stopped; traffic normalizing. They want postmortem and commit to adjusting client batch sizes.
sam_sre: created tracker issue INC-4999990001 with timeline, logs, and commands used. Suspect misconfigured customer batch scheduler sending oversized batches — outreach and remediation task assigned to @raj_cse.
sam_sre: marking incident mitigated; will run RCA with infra team. Action items: 1) tighten per-tenant batching quotas, 2) add emergency autoscale path that pre-warms overflow GPUs, 3) add alerts to detect sustained single-tenant queue growth, 4) customer education on batch sizing.
erin_oncall: thanks team. closing paging rotation for this incident. :white_check_mark:
